svg.title: Direct-repeat recombination
svg.desc: Two parallel ribbons have directly oriented purple and blue repeats around A B ... Y Z. The ribbons fold so the repeats can exchange at the X. The outgoing arms pass over the right bends. The shorter deletion product joins purple to blue. The closed acentric ring retains A B ... Y Z, with blue joined to purple. Chevrons show continuation beyond the sequence window. The paired ribbons have no specified molecular or replication state.
